name: The Great Spa Towns of Europe
countries: Italy, France, Austria, Belgium, United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, Germany, Czechia
description: Eleven spa towns scattered across seven countries, from Bath in England to Karlovy Vary in Czechia, grew up around natural mineral springs. Between the 18th century and the 1930s, they filled with pump rooms, colonnades, bathhouses, casinos and theatres set in landscaped gardens. You can still stroll between drinking halls and grand villas, or sample the waters, as visitors once did.
